mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts below 1.3 million units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and residential investment, leading to a contraction in aggregate demand and negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 159,000 signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing output and supply-side contraction, which signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal exhibits Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 725 billion dollars combined with rising housing starts above 1.35 million units signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 320.0 with a federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates disinflationary pressure and a lagging monetary policy response, which increases the risk of deflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 23,500 billion dollars over the past 5 months signals a contraction in aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is below 23,500 billion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.1% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 159,200 signals a labor market weakening, reducing household income and consumption, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
